run_benchmark_agent: run a benchmark for a Diplomacy agent measuring order generation or message generation timing
load_game_from_json: load a Diplomacy game from a JSON file and optionally roll back to a specific phase
run_benchmark_with_timing: run the benchmark agent with timing context logging results to a timing log file
load_game_new_empty: load a new empty Diplomacy game when no game JSON file is provided
run_benchmark_generate_messages: run the benchmark agent to measure message generation timing across multiple message iterations
